title: 就业意外转负：市场为何不慌？，生产率回升或是关键
speaker: Cathie Wood

segments.en: On this episode of In the Know, we talk a lot about that scary looking employment report today.
segments.zh: 在本期《知你所知》中，我们讨论了今天那份看似吓人的就业报告。

segments.en: It's not as scary as it looks. And we spend a lot of time talking about the impact of the technology revolution.
segments.zh: 它并没有看起来那么吓人。我们还花了很多时间讨论技术革命的影响。

segments.en: Greetings everyone. I'm Kathy Wood and this is In The Know.
segments.zh: 大家好，我是凯西·伍德，这里是《知你所知》。

segments.en: The employment report today was somewhat scary on the surface, and we understand the fears.
segments.zh: 今天的就业报告表面上看有些令人担忧，我们理解这种担忧。

segments.en: The actual employment number so this is the increase or decrease in non farm payroll
segments.zh: 实际的就业数字，即非农就业人数的增减，

segments.en: employment was minus twenty three thousand.
Expectation was for plus eighty thousand.
And perhaps more important, the previous three months were revised down by one hundred and three thousand.
segments.zh: 或许更重要的是，前三个月的数据被下修了十万三千。

segments.en: So that means a three month moving average employment increased only twenty thousand per month.
segments.zh: 这意味着三个月移动平均就业人数每月仅增加两万。

segments.en: So that's very slow. Now, if you look inside the report, there are a few things we found interesting.
segments.zh: 所以增长非常缓慢。现在，如果你深入看这份报告，我们发现了一些有趣的点。

segments.en: But if you parse through the various age cohorts, it was the boomers who were retiring.
segments.zh: 但分年龄段看，主要是婴儿潮一代退休。

segments.en: They accounted for the biggest drop in the participation.
segments.zh: 他们对参与率下降的贡献最大。

segments.en: And the sixteen to twenty four year old category.
We've been talking a lot about that. And that was the second biggest contributor.
segments.zh: 我们一直在讨论这个，它是第二大贡献因素。
